tagline: Know where your revenue comes from
brief: Free, self-hostable, multi-site web analytics: traffic, goals, revenue attribution and AI crawlers. The mark should stand apart from bar-chart and blue-violet analytics brands, borrow Matomo's confident monoline style, and work as a 16 px favicon.
criteria: Distinct from every competitor on the shelf, readable at 16 px, one colour friendly, ownable colour.

concepts.name: Orbit
concepts.idea: A planet (terra) circled by a rising orbit that passes behind it and in front, ending in one data point.
rationale: Over-under weave gives depth with a single monoline, in the spirit of Matomo
The orbit rises at 30°: growth without another bar chart
The satellite dot carries over the data point of the previous logo
Green is unclaimed in the category (Plausible violet, DataFast coral, Matomo teal)

recommendation: Orbit, lime on Terra Night for the product and app icon, Forest on light backgrounds.
next_steps: Replace the logo in the web app and favicon
Run a trademark search before public launch
Extend the orbit line into illustrations and empty states
